customManagers.description: OmniRoute image is pinned by Chart.yaml appVersion. values.yaml sets tag: "" so the helm-values manager has nothing to anchor on. Quotes are optional in YAML, so match either style.

bumpVersions.name: omniroute chart version
bumpVersions.description: ct.yaml sets check-version-increment, and release.yml rejects a changed chart under an existing tag. An appVersion-only PR fails CI.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge appVersion patch bumps. The lint job is a required status check on main and the ruleset requires 0 approvals, so GitHub auto-merge waits for CI then merges. Minor and major wait for review.

Hold every bump 3 days so a withdrawn upstream release surfaces first. A longer window does not stall updates: Renovate walks releases newest-first and takes the first one older than the window, so the chart simply trails upstream by that much. 3 days is the chosen lag against upstream's 1-3 day cadence.
